project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 5 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 41 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Madeley qualifies as a local detour through Blists Hill Victorian Town and CHURCH OF ST MICHAEL. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Madeley: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Madeley offers Blists Hill Victorian Town, CHURCH OF ST MICHAEL, Presbytery of Roman Catholic Church of St Mary within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Blists Hill Victorian Town
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Blists Hill Victorian Town and CHURCH OF ST MICHAEL, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Presbytery of Roman Catholic Church of St Mary
